pr_title: roachtest: enable runtime assertions in nightlies without metamorphic constants
pr_body:
This PR reenables runtime assertions in roachtest nightlies with a default probability of 0.2, while disabling metamorphic constants by default.

-------

[roachtest: enable assertions in nightlies without metamorphic constants](https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pull/128699/commits/1a723bbddb43b2ab4076caf95b373026e49e5d1d) 

In https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pull/114618 we disabled runtime assertions and metamorphic constants due to their flakiness.

Here we reenable them but with metamorphic constants disabled, as they are the more disruptive of the two. We also change the framework to take in a --metamorphic-cockroach-ea-probability instead of hardcoding the value.

[roachtest: route runtime assertion build timeouts to test-eng](https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pull/128699/commits/58862687a0bc5366bd7724f6043319539826bb28) 

As we determine the stability of runtime assertions, temporarily route all timeout failures to test-eng to reduce noise for other teams.

Release note: none
Fixes: #128841
Epic: none

issue_context.title: roachtest: run nightlies with assertions enabled
issue_context.body:
In https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pull/111949 we briefly enabled roachtest nightlies to run with the `crdb_test` flag on. This enabled roachtests to be run with runtime assertions as well as metamorphic constants. However, due to the "metamorphic" nature of metamorphic constants, it was difficult to test all possible combinations/constants and tests frequently flaked. To reduce noise, we disabled both runtime assertions and metamorphic constants in https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pull/114618.

Runtime assertions however, seemed to be more stable. In terms of infra flakes, we expect they might contribute to longer run times, but other failures are likely actual assertions hit or issues with the assertion themselves. We should look into reenabling just runtime assertions on roachtest nightlies.

Runtime assertions and metamorphic constants are both enabled by default when building with `--crdb_test`. To disable metamorphic constants, `COCKROACH_INTERNAL_DISABLE_METAMORPHIC_TESTING=true` should be passed in when the cluster is started.

Related work/issues also includes:

- [ ] The roachprod/roachtest framework uses metamorphic testing/constants and runtime assertions interchangeably. Now that we are only running with runtime assertions, we should make a clearer distinction.
- [ ] The metamorphic constant framework unconditionally logs constants on init. Passing in `COCKROACH_INTERNAL_DISABLE_METAMORPHIC_TESTING=true` on cluster startup is sufficient to disable constants in the cluster, but it won't stop logging on every cockroach binary invocation, i.e. `./cockroach workload`
- [ ] Since we suspect this might lead to longer run times, we should route timeouts to test-eng while we let this change stabalize.

Jira issue: CRDB-41227

review_comments: Curious why the test was failing _with_ `$`?

I've added it back in.

Because of timeout + runtime assertions = test eng owner check, we now use a `errorWithOwnership` instead of a regular error for timeouts. The former contains `[owner=*]` which messed with the regex here. 

I changed it to only use `errorWithOwnership` when its the above runtime assertion + timeout condition, instead of unconditionally.
